name: Higgsfield API
desc: One API key for fifty-plus image, video and audio models
desc_zh: 一个密钥调用五十多个图片、视频、音频模型的 API
solves: Signing up with each model vendor meant many keys and queues; send prompts to one endpoint and get files back.
solves_zh: 每家模型都要单独注册、各自排队；现在把提示词发到一个接口，拿回文件链接。
best_for: Your app needs three video models but you want one bill; route them all through the Higgsfield API.
best_for_zh: 应用要接三个视频模型，又只想付一份账；全部走 Higgsfield API。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog (entry 'Higgsfield API')）。 The developer platform is branded 'Open Higgsfield AI' at open.higgsfield.ai; higgsfield.ai/api redirects there. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：原地址 higgsfield.ai/api 跳转到开发者平台 open.higgsfield.ai/explore，直接给跳转后的入口。 首次公开日期来源：https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog
